styleLock.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, mist blue #D8EAF6 water-themed backgrounds for benefit and CTA shots, deep charcoal #1E2226 low-key backgrounds for motor macro and waterproof trust shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle cool rim light and soft contact shadows; low-key directional light only on dark macro/trust shots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC for scenes, seamless studio backdrops elsewhere, subtle water droplets on dark surfaces
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2B2F33 on light grounds and #FFFFFF on dark grounds, with thin-line labels for feature annotations
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and rounded circular callout bubbles, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable upright product stance, consistent product scale across the set, hero angle reused for variant grid, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh personal-care electronics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, mist blue #D8EAF6, deep charcoal #2B2F33 and one water-blue accent #6FA8DC; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle cool rim light and soft contact shadows, low-key directional light only on dark macro and trust shots; modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2B2F33 on light grounds and #FFFFFF on dark grounds; consistent rounded circular info bubbles and thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product stance and consistent product scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view, the product standing upright and centered, full product visible and not clipped by the frame, the product filling 60-70% of the frame so the composition reads complete. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no gradient background, no cut-off edges.

shots.displayName: 手动牙刷清洁盲区痛点
shots.intent: 放大手动牙刷刷不干净的摩擦痛点，引出声波替代方案
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, identical straight-on camera and crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat heavy dim light; right panel bright fresh clean light
shots.background: left panel dim grey basin edge #9AA3AA; right panel bright white #FFFFFF with light mist blue #D8EAF6 glow
shots.props: left panel: an ordinary manual toothbrush lying flat with a few stubborn residue dots beside it; right panel: clean water bubbles
shots.textZone: one short label per panel, 「{callout_1}」 on the left and 「{callout_2}」 on the right, in #2B2F33
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on camera and framing. Left panel: an ordinary manual toothbrush lying flat on a dim grey basin edge #9AA3AA under flat heavy light, a few stubborn residue dots beside it, conveying hard-to-clean frustration. Right panel: {product} standing upright in bright fresh light with clean water bubbles, conveying effortless deep cleaning. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Each toothbrush fills 40-50% of its panel so both sides read as full compositions. One short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2B2F33 placed near the top of each panel. Negative: no real face or mouth, no teeth, no fabricated statistics, no invented brand names, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

provenance.notes: 从 12 张声波电动牙刷爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌字与型号标识、模特面部与身份、原文案与英文装饰小字、会员二维码与店铺角标；防水/续航等参数一律以 {selling_point} 与 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写，不继承源图具体数值；产品一律以 {product} 占位；人物镜头改为仅手部与手臂的通用构图并加入手部与牙齿防畸形负面清单。
